thruster_followup.environment: QEMU AArch64 virt, HVF, one vCPU, PCI storage and VirtIO input
thruster_followup.command: QEMU_VIRT='-machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-strut-spring
checks: Placed a third mass and dragged a thruster from the first mass to it, with action key 0.
After switching to play, two idle captures were identical in the star-field crop. Holding 0 for 2.5 seconds changed 25 pixels in that crop and 339 pixels in the ship/mass crop.
Escape returned to the graphical terminal; 40+2 returned 42 and zstatus reported failed=0.
thruster_followup.limits: The visual comparison establishes a response to the control in this setup, not numerical force accuracy, connector mechanics, every thrust direction, live UTM, or Pi behavior.
